talents.name: White Leyline Attunement
talents.description: When you Draw Mana, allies within Attunement Range regain health equal to your tier.

talents.name: Concordant Presence
talents.description: When an ally within Attunement Range succeeds on a test, the next ally testing that same skill this round raises the stakes.

talents.name: Guiding Signal
talents.description: Spend 1 Investiture to designate a creature within Attunement Range. The next ally who tests against it this round raises the stakes.
talents.flavor: Point. Trust. Watch them find the same line.

talents.name: Unity of Purpose
talents.description: When two or more allies aid the same test, raise the stakes.

talents.name: Beacon of Stability
talents.description: When you Draw Mana, spend 1 Investiture to remove one condition from an ally within Attunement Range.

talents.name: Shared Conviction
talents.description: When an ally within Attunement Range would fail a test, you may spend 2 focus and 1 Investiture to add your White modifier to their result. This may change the outcome.

talents.name: Ordered Advance
talents.description: Spend 1 Investiture. This round, when you move, allies within 10 ft may move half their Speed without provoking Reactions.

talents.name: Mending Aura
talents.description: You may spend an Opportunity and 1 Investiture to restore half [Tier][Die] Health to each ally within [Size].

talents.name: Pillar of Order
talents.description: When an ally within Attunement Range rolls a Complication, spend 1 Investiture to change it to a blank face.

talents.name: Guardian Stance
talents.description: While an ally is adjacent to you, you both gain +1 Deflect.

talents.name: Interposing Shield
talents.description: When an ally within 10 ft takes damage, move up to 10 ft toward them and reduce that damage by half [Tier][Die].

talents.name: Retributive Guard
talents.description: When an ally adjacent to you takes damage from an enemy within Attunement Range, deal Spirit damage equal to your tier to the attacker.
talents.flavor: Hurt my people. Find out what that costs.

talents.name: Shared Burden
talents.description: When an ally adjacent to you takes damage, you may spend 1 Investiture to take half of that damage in their place.

talents.name: Devoted Conduit
talents.description: When an ally within Attunement Range takes damage intended for another creature, reduce that damage by half [Tier][Die].

talents.name: Shield Wall
talents.description: When two or more allies are adjacent to you, attacks against them deal [Tier][Die] less damage.

talents.name: Unbreakable Line
talents.description: Once per round, when an ally adjacent to you would drop to 0 HP, they drop to 1 HP instead.

talents.name: Hardy
talents.description: Gain +1 maximum HP per level, including previous levels.

talents.name: Terms of Accord
talents.description: When you and a character within Attunement Range verbally agree on a shared objective, spend 1 Investiture. You both gain +1 to tests pursuing the objective for the scene. One active accord per character.

talents.name: Counterpoint
talents.description: When an enemy within Attunement Range successfully influences against an ally, test White. On success, you may spend 1 Investiture to negate the effect and Disorient the enemy until your next turn.
talents.flavor: Every argument has a counter. Speak it.

talents.name: Disciplined Mind
talents.description: You and allies within Attunement Range reduce the focus cost to resist influence by 1 (minimum 1).

talents.name: Overwhelming Authority
talents.description: When you successfully influence a character, spend 1 Investiture. The target also becomes Disoriented until the end of your next turn.

talents.name: Bound by Word
talents.description: When an ally within Attunement Range tests in pursuit of an active accord's objective, they may use your White modifier in place of their own.

talents.name: Collective Resolve
talents.description: Spend an Opportunity and 1 Investiture to grant an ally within Attunement Range Determined.

talents.name: Unyielding Accord
talents.description: Allies within Attunement Range gain +1 to Cognitive and Spiritual defenses while adjacent to another ally.

talents.name: Voice of Authority
talents.description: When an enemy within Attunement Range targets an ally with a hostile action, spend 1 Investiture to impose disadvantage. Once per round.
